paragraphs.en: At registration, Tang Yue wrote five names in the gate ledger and passed the pen along. The handbook required a shared log and every member's signature at the exit; its smaller review desk also accepted evidence of faulty instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 報名時，唐悅在門口名冊寫下五人姓名，再傳筆。手冊要求共用紀錄簿，出口須全員簽字；旁邊較小的複核桌也收指示錯誤的證據。

paragraphs.en: Outside the assembly hall, someone had used acid to strip old glue from a notice and left a broom across the walkway. Mei said they should construct a clear entrance, and Tang Yue asked the staff to cooperate rather than blame one another.
paragraphs.zh: 集會廳外，有人用酸液除去公告上的舊膠，卻把掃帚橫放在人行道上。梅嵐說應先建出暢通入口；唐悅請工作人員合作，而不是互相指責。

paragraphs.en: The fastest-looking street ended at a gate built for one person.
paragraphs.zh: 看似最快的街道，盡頭卻是只容一人通行的門。

paragraphs.en: A maintenance drawing showed a second gate with five signature boxes. The copper ticket counter carried a cartoon of a coward who fled every challenge. A guide tried to entertain the visitors with it, but Tang Yue watched his serious facial expression when he noticed the narrow door.
paragraphs.zh: 維修圖上畫著第二道門，旁邊有五格簽名欄。銅製售票櫃檯上畫著總是逃避挑戰的懦夫。導覽員想藉此娛樂觀眾；唐悅卻注意到他發現窄門時嚴肅的臉部表情。

paragraphs.en: Mei wanted to test the tempting short street, while Yu Qian asked who would be left behind. "One person could pass that gate," Mei said. Yu Qian pointed at the five empty boxes. "Then why are there five spaces for names?"
paragraphs.zh: 梅嵐想測試誘人的捷徑，俞芊則問誰會被落下。「一個人就能過那道門，」梅嵐說。俞芊指著五個空格：「那為什麼要留五個簽名欄？」

paragraphs.en: A ministry clerk warned that players must not interfere with the simulated opera performance. Yet the supposedly persuasive instructions failed to describe the strange phenomenon: two identical arrows pointed toward different exits.
paragraphs.zh: 一名主管部門職員警告參賽者不得干擾模擬歌劇演出。然而那份看似有說服力的指示，卻無法解釋奇怪現象：兩支相同箭頭竟指向不同出口。

paragraphs.en: Fang Ze, who audited accounts for a living, asked whether a team could use the wider gate without buying a faster ticket. The clerk pointed to an unfilled box on the maintenance drawing. Mei Lan set down her scenery tools and measured the space between its posts. Yu Qian, a nursing assistant, asked everyone to stand where they could turn without bumping one another. Duan Ya drew the arrangement in her architecture notebook, leaving room beside each figure to show the bags they carried. Their first attempt stopped when Fang's satchel caught the ticket counter. He had measured his own shoulders and forgotten the things that traveled with him. Mei shifted the queue line instead of pulling him through. The clerk then brought the original gate form, which did indeed contain five spaces. Tang asked him to watch a complete group pass before stamping anything. The short street saved steps for the first person, but the others had to wait behind its narrow turn. At the wider gate, each member could see who was still approaching. Duan marked the waiting space on her drawing while Fang recorded the full group time. When they returned to the clerk, they brought both measurements and the folded maintenance sheet. Tang could not yet explain the contest's ranking, but she could show exactly which entrance would let them finish the first stage together.
paragraphs.zh: 以稽核帳目為業的方澤問，不買快票能否走寬門。書吏指維修圖的空格。梅嵐放下布景工具，量兩門柱間距；護理助理俞芊請大家站到能轉身、不撞人的位置。段芽在建築筆記畫出人形，旁邊留出隨身袋的空間。第一次嘗試，方澤的包勾住櫃檯，只好停下。他量了肩寬，卻忘了隨身物。梅嵐移排隊線，沒有硬拉他過門。書吏拿來原門表，果然有五格。唐悅請他先看完整隊伍通過再蓋章。短街讓第一人少走幾步，其他人卻卡在窄彎後等待。寬門那邊，每人都看得見尚未到的隊友。段芽在圖上標等待空間，方澤記全隊時間。回複核桌時，他們帶著兩組數值和摺好的維修圖。唐悅還不能解釋排名，卻能確切指出哪個入口能讓他們一起完成第一關。

paragraphs.en: Duan kept both routes on the same sheet, with the whole-group timing written below each entrance.
paragraphs.zh: 段芽把兩條路留同頁，在各入口下寫全組計時。

paragraphs.en: All five signed the wider exit and earned a review seal instead of a speed bonus. They drew the safer route beneath a shady awning, ignoring a slogan that promised victory to the fastest team. Duan Ya checked the map's actual usage with a youthful volunteer, who admitted it had never been tested by a whole group.
paragraphs.zh: 五人簽下較寬出口，取得一枚複核印章，而非速度獎勵。他們在陰暗遮棚下畫出較安全的路線，不理會宣稱最快者必勝的標語。段芽和年輕志工核對地圖的實際用途，志工承認從未讓完整隊伍測試。

paragraphs.en: The public screen ranked their team last even though nobody had been abandoned.
paragraphs.zh: 公開螢幕把他們排在最後，儘管沒有人被遺下。

questions.question: Why does Fang stop during the team's first attempt at the gate?
options: His satchel catches the ticket counter.
The clerk removes all five signature boxes.
The wider gate closes before anyone reaches it.
questions.explanation: 方澤只量肩寬，忘了隨身包；包勾住售票櫃檯，使第一次嘗試停下。

questions.question: What do the five receive after using the wider exit?
options: An extra ticket for the fastest member only.
A review seal rather than a speed bonus.
Permission to finish without signing the log.
questions.explanation: 五人簽下寬出口，取得的是複核印章；速度排名仍然落後。

paragraphs.en: A delivery cart stood with one wheel against the square's high curb. Duan Ya found its route on the paper plan, then turned her tablet toward the guide; the same corner was blank on the digital map.
paragraphs.zh: 廣場上，一輛送貨車的車輪抵著高路緣。段芽在紙圖找到路線，再把平板轉向導覽員：數位地圖同一角卻是空白。

paragraphs.en: A collector asked for an autograph on the route card, but the five refused to carve a name into public property. The square advertised convenience for everyone; hiding the inaccessible curb behind painted flowers felt like cruelty disguised as decoration.
paragraphs.zh: 收藏者要求在路線卡上簽名，五人卻拒絕在公共財產上刻字。廣場宣稱提供人人便利；用彩繪花朵遮住難以通行的路緣，實際上是把殘酷偽裝成裝飾。

paragraphs.en: A printed timetable assumed every delivery rider could jump a high curb.
paragraphs.zh: 印製的時刻表假設送貨員都能跳上高路緣。

paragraphs.en: Duan Ya found that an earlier route included a ramp omitted from the digital copy. An elastic strap kept a fake explosive prop from falling onto a display. A recent immigrant who worked as a guide gave useful feedback: the initial map showed the ramp, but the updated one did not.
paragraphs.zh: 段芽發現舊路線有坡道，數位版本卻刪掉了。一條彈性帶固定著展示用的假爆裂物道具。擔任導覽員的新移民提出有用回饋：初版地圖畫了坡道，更新版本卻刪掉了。

paragraphs.en: Fang wanted to file a formal complaint, but Mei feared losing their only remaining hour. "We can ask the next office to sign," Fang suggested. Duan Ya shook her head. "A signature will help only if they check what disappeared."
paragraphs.zh: 方澤主張正式申訴，梅嵐卻怕耗掉僅剩的一小時。「我們可以請下一個辦公室簽核，」方澤提議。段芽搖頭：「簽名要有幫助，得先查清什麼消失了。」

paragraphs.en: A little mischief appeared on the floor: a painted paw print led to a locked office. A prevention notice said that only prominent guests enjoyed the privilege of entering, although the passage was marked public on the printed plan.
paragraphs.zh: 地板上有個惡作劇般的爪印圖案，通往上鎖辦公室。預防事故的告示聲稱只有知名貴賓享有進入特權，但紙圖明明把通道標成公共空間。

paragraphs.en: The guide could not authorize a correction, but she knew where the previous plan was kept. Fang requested its date before asking who had removed the ramp. The older sheet bore an approval stamp and a space for a later check that nobody had signed. Mei wanted to begin the walk while Fang handled the forms. Tang gave them separate tasks within sight of one another: Fang would copy the approval details, and Mei would inspect the ramp without moving the loaded cart. Its surface was sound, but a display stand blocked the lower landing. They asked the attendant to move the stand and noted its former position on Duan's sketch. Only then did Yu try the route with the cart empty, keeping a guide at the far end. Fang timed the passage from the shop door rather than from the top of the curb. Starting at the curb would have hidden the very delay they were investigating. When the station accepted their photographs, it stamped the submission but left the ranking unchanged. Tang asked for the reason in the shared log. The attendant wrote that an unsigned update needed review by another office. Nobody promised the missing signature could be obtained before the hour ended. Outside, the rival captain was already waiting with a different offer, and Fang kept the original plan folded inside their common notebook.
paragraphs.zh: 導覽員無權改圖，卻知道舊圖放哪裡。方澤先問日期，沒有先問誰刪坡道。舊頁有核准章，後續檢查欄卻沒人簽。梅嵐想趁方澤辦表單先走路線，唐悅讓兩人在彼此視線內分工：方澤抄核准資料，梅嵐查看坡道，先不動載貨車。坡面良好，下端平臺卻被展示架擋住。他們請管理員移架，段芽在圖上記原位，俞芊才推空車試走，遠端有導覽員等候。方澤從店門起算，不從路緣上方算，免得藏掉正在查的延誤。關卡收照蓋收件章，排名不變，唐悅要求把理由寫進共用簿。職員寫下：未簽核更新須另一辦公室審查。沒人保證能在這一小時結束前補簽。外頭競爭隊長已等著提出另一交易，方澤把原圖摺入共用筆記。

paragraphs.en: Their submission preserved the photographed paper plan, the measured ramp, and the request for a dated sign-off.
paragraphs.zh: 呈件保留紙圖照片、坡道量測，以及要求註日期簽核的申請。

paragraphs.en: The station accepted the evidence but refused to alter the ranking immediately. A shopkeeper remarked that businesses could not prosper if every delivery shift ended in a detour. Fang replied that a broken timetable could ruin a business too, and wrote down the actual times instead of guessing.
paragraphs.zh: 關卡收下證據，卻拒絕立即修正排名。店主評論說，每一班送貨都繞路，商家便難以興盛。方澤回答，錯誤的時刻表同樣會毀掉生意，於是記下每班實際時間，不再猜測。

paragraphs.en: A rival team offered to trade a signature for a shortcut, raising an ethical question.
paragraphs.zh: 競爭隊伍提議用簽名交換捷徑，引出新的倫理問題。

questions.question: Why does Fang time the delivery route from the shop door?
options: The shopkeeper has forbidden photographs of the ramp.
Starting at the curb would hide part of the delay.
The old approval stamp gives a time only for that door.
questions.explanation: 若從路緣上方起算，會漏掉到路緣前的延誤；所以他從店門量整段。

questions.question: How does the station respond to the ramp evidence?
options: It immediately awards the team the fastest-route prize.
It destroys the earlier plan and cancels the next gate.
It accepts the evidence but leaves the ranking unchanged.
questions.explanation: 關卡蓋收件章，表示未簽核更新須另一處審查，沒有立即改排名。

paragraphs.en: Fog rolled low across the footbridge, swallowing the painted edge before the team reached it. Duan Ya covered her mouth and stopped; Tang Yue raised a hand to tell the stage operator they needed a pause before choosing either route.
paragraphs.zh: 霧貼著步橋流來，小隊還未到，彩繪邊線已被吞沒。段芽掩嘴停下；唐悅舉手告訴舞臺操作員，選路前需要暫停。

paragraphs.en: An accidental opening in the painted barrier revealed an old stair. Fang blinked at the steep drop. The warning used the brutal word 'failure' for anyone who slowed down, and thick theatrical fog made Duan Ya choke.
paragraphs.zh: 彩繪障礙物間意外露出一道舊樓梯。方澤望著陡坡眨了眨眼。警告牌殘酷地把放慢腳步的人叫作「失敗者」，濃厚的舞臺霧更讓段芽嗆咳。

paragraphs.en: Dense stage fog hid the safety rail and made rushing hazardous.
paragraphs.zh: 濃厚舞台霧遮住護欄，匆忙通過很危險。

paragraphs.en: The floor markings continued beyond the fog where the handrail was strongest. The music's composition was calm, but the team had to evaluate a grave safety risk. Tang Yue thanked a volunteer with genuine gratitude for bringing an inspection sheet; intelligence here meant checking the sheet, not showing off clever guesses.
paragraphs.zh: 霧後的地面標記延伸到扶手最堅固之處。音樂編曲平靜，小隊卻必須評估嚴重的安全風險。唐悅真心感謝一位志工送來檢查表；此處的判斷力是核實表單，而非炫耀聰明猜測。

paragraphs.en: Yu Qian argued for the safer line; a spectator called their caution weakness. "I don't need you to admire my courage," Yu Qian said. "I need you to hold the measuring tape where I can see it."
paragraphs.zh: 俞芊主張安全路線，一位觀眾卻譏笑他們太膽小。「我不需要你讚賞我的勇敢，」俞芊說，「我需要你把捲尺放到我看得見的位置。」

paragraphs.en: A mild breeze crossed the mountainous model. An old philosopher's quotation warned against neglect, but Mei wondered whether reciting it would offend residents who needed practical help. They went to inspect the handrail instead.
paragraphs.zh: 微風吹過山地模型。舊哲學家的引文提醒人們別疏忽；梅嵐卻問，光背引文是否會冒犯真正需要協助的居民。於是他們轉去檢查扶手。

paragraphs.en: The operator reduced the fog and left the clock running. Mei objected, but Yu asked first whether Duan could breathe comfortably. A volunteer opened the side screen, letting a gentle current clear their waiting place. From there, the team could see the floor line continuing toward a stronger handrail. Fang photographed the line before anyone stood on it, then gave the tape's far end to a member of the other team. Measuring together was slower than guessing the curve. It also kept the tape from dragging over the drop. At the resting point, they marked the space needed for two people to pass without one turning sideways. A spectator urged them to hurry because the other team was already near the exit. Tang asked that team whether its last walker could wait at the safe turn and confirm the route for those behind. Their captain agreed and later signed a witness card describing exactly where the rail had supported them. Mei attached the card to the measurements rather than treating it as a gift of points. Before leaving, Duan copied the unsigned inspection report's office number. The fog machine's hiss returned after they were clear. Fang could still hear the spectators, but the person holding his measuring tape had become more useful than the people urging him to run.
paragraphs.zh: 操作員減霧，計時卻不停。梅嵐抗議，俞芊先問段芽能否舒服呼吸。志工拉開側幕，微風吹清等待處。從那裡能看見地線延向較強扶手。方澤在有人踩前拍線，把捲尺遠端交給另一隊成員。一起量比猜彎道慢，卻也避免尺帶拖過陡邊。休息點上，他們標出兩人能相錯、不必側身的空間。觀眾催快，因另一隊已近出口。唐悅問那隊最後的步行者能否在安全彎等候，替後方確認路線。隊長答應，後來簽見證卡，說清哪段扶手支撐過他們。梅嵐把卡附在量測旁，沒有把它當贈送分數。離開前，段芽抄下未簽檢查表的辦公室編號。等眾人離開，霧機又嘶響。方澤仍聽見觀眾，卻發現替自己握尺的人，比催跑的人有用。

paragraphs.en: Mei attached the safe-turn measurements to the other team's witness card, preserving the route another group had checked.
paragraphs.zh: 梅嵐把安全彎量測附在另一隊見證卡旁，保留別組查過的路。

paragraphs.en: The other team reached safety first but shared its witness card with them. The team wanted reform, not revenge against the judge who had mocked them. Fang noticed a tendency to hurry whenever spectators shouted. He placed a twig beside the safe turn, and Yu Qian urged everyone to slow their steps.
paragraphs.zh: 另一隊先抵達安全處，卻將見證卡借給他們。小隊想要改革，不想向嘲笑他們的評審報復。方澤發現觀眾一叫嚷，大家就容易急著走。他在安全轉角放根細枝作記號，俞芊催促眾人放慢腳步。

paragraphs.en: An unsigned inspection report pointed toward the contest's secret scoring office.
paragraphs.zh: 一份沒簽名的檢查報告指向競賽的祕密評分室。

questions.question: What does the team do when Duan cannot breathe comfortably in the fog?
options: It sends her alone to find the unsigned report.
It uses the narrowest bridge line to save time.
It pauses and asks for the fog to be reduced.
questions.explanation: 段芽嗆咳時，唐悅先要求暫停；操作員減霧，志工開側幕通風。

questions.question: What does the other team contribute after reaching safety first?
options: A witness card describing the checked route.
A replacement score with no supporting measurements.
The key to the secret scoring office.
questions.explanation: 對方先安全抵達，仍分享見證卡，記明哪段扶手支撐過他們。

paragraphs.en: In the former bank, a card drawer scraped against its swollen wooden frame. Tang Yue held the drawer steady while the librarian freed it, and a row of paper requests appeared where the search machine had shown an empty category.
paragraphs.zh: 舊銀行裡，一格卡片抽屜刮著受潮木框。唐悅扶穩，館員把它鬆開，露出整排紙申請；搜尋機先前卻把這類顯示為空。

paragraphs.en: To accomplish the task, they needed written approval before touching the records. A children's game in the entrance was meant to amuse visitors, but a ball continued to bounce against the shelves, producing a continual disturbance.
paragraphs.zh: 要完成任務，他們得先取得書面核准才能接觸紀錄。入口的兒童遊戲原本為了逗樂訪客，球卻不停彈向書架，形成持續干擾。

paragraphs.en: The machine labeled every unreadable card as a failed citizen request.
paragraphs.zh: 機器把所有難以辨識的卡都判定成失敗的市民申請。

paragraphs.en: The librarian demonstrated a paper index that the machine never scanned. The earnest librarian tried not to disappoint anyone, yet she emphasized that even a visiting embassy representative must follow the same record policy. Tang Yue repeated the emphasis in a clear request rather than asking for special treatment.
paragraphs.zh: 圖書館員展示一份機器從未掃描的紙本索引。認真的圖書館員不願使人失望，仍強調連來訪的大使館代表也得遵守相同的紀錄政策。唐悅在申請中再次強調公平規則，沒有要求特別待遇。

paragraphs.en: Tang Yue wanted to preserve the catalog; Fang insisted that people needed an immediate answer. The librarian asked, "Do you want a fast answer or the right request?" Tang Yue replied, "Both, if possible. Evidence first, if not."
paragraphs.zh: 唐悅想先保存目錄，方澤則主張人們急需答覆。圖書館員問：「你們要快答案，還是正確申請？」唐悅答：「能兼顧最好；不能的話，證據優先。」

paragraphs.en: A mystery novel about a murderer lay in the margin of an exhibit, beside a model planet in orbit. Fang called the dramatic cover nonsense as evidence; it showed a story, not actual possession of the missing records, and passive speculation could not solve their problem.
paragraphs.zh: 一部寫殺人犯的推理小說放在展覽角落，旁邊是繞行軌道的行星模型。方澤說拿戲劇性封面當證據簡直胡說；那只是故事，不代表誰持有遺失紀錄，消極猜測解決不了問題。

paragraphs.en: Fang wanted to search every card at once. The librarian showed him how easily their order could be lost: a tiny reference number linked each request to a second drawer. She gave the five a tray with numbered places and allowed only one card out at a time. Mei moved the children's ball game away from the shelves with the attendant's permission. Yu placed a chair beside the tray so the older librarian could check the references without standing throughout the search. Duan copied the layout before they began. The first promising card concerned a street with the same name in another district. Fang nearly wrote down its answer, then noticed the different boundary mark. They returned it to its place and followed the second reference. That card led to the public application filed before the digital index existed. Its paper edges were worn, but the filing number matched the librarian's register. Tang requested a correction that linked the paper source to the digital category instead of declaring the machine useless. The librarian approved a scan with the original position recorded. When the second seal was issued, Fang asked to keep the wrong district reference in their notes as well. It showed why their first quick answer would have sent them to the wrong neighborhood, and why the restored request deserved a closer look.
paragraphs.zh: 方澤想一次翻遍，館員示範順序多容易散：每張卡的小索引號連著另一抽屜。她給五人有編號位置的托盤，一次只准取一張。梅嵐經管理員同意移開兒童球戲，俞芊在盤旁放椅，讓年長館員不用全程站著核索引，段芽先畫布局。第一張看似有望，卻屬另一街區的同名街。方澤差點抄下答案，才注意到不同界標。他們放回，追第二索引，找到數位目錄出現前已歸檔的公共申請。紙緣雖磨，號碼與館員簿吻合。唐悅申請把紙本來源連到數位分類，沒有宣稱機器全無用。館員准掃描，並記原位。第二枚章核發時，方澤也保留錯街區索引；它說明第一個快答案為何會把人帶錯社區，以及恢復的申請為何值得細查。

paragraphs.en: The correction linked the restored application to both paper cross-references, allowing the librarian to trace its place.
paragraphs.zh: 更正把恢復的申請連到兩份紙本交叉索引，館員能追它的位置。

paragraphs.en: A lost request was restored to the stage and the team gained its second seal. A visiting researcher helped a translator read a rhyme written in the old catalog code. Its urgent message was simple: the public application had been filed on paper long before the digital index existed.
paragraphs.zh: 遺失的申請恢復到關卡資料，小隊拿到第二枚印章。來訪研究員協助翻譯員讀懂舊目錄代碼裡的一段押韻文。當中急迫的訊息很簡單：那份公共申請早在數位索引存在前，就已寫在紙上歸檔。

paragraphs.en: The restored request belonged to a neighborhood marked for future closure.
paragraphs.zh: 這份申請來自一個被標註未來要關閉的社區。

questions.question: Why is the first promising catalog card rejected as the answer?
options: It concerns a street with the same name in another district.
The librarian refuses to let anyone copy its reference number.
The card was printed after the current digital index.
questions.explanation: 方澤看見不同界標，確認首張卡是另一街區的同名街，才繼續追索引。

questions.question: What earns the team its second review seal?
options: Replacing all catalog cards with a new mystery novel.
Restoring the lost paper request to the stage's records.
Proving that every machine search is always wrong.
questions.explanation: 小隊提交能追到紙本來源的更正，恢復遺失申請，得到第二枚章。

paragraphs.en: Two clocks hung above the terminal, but their hands moved when different things happened. Fang watched the first jump as a model vehicle crossed a sensor; the second kept counting while the passengers were still searching for the reception desk.
paragraphs.zh: 轉運站上方掛兩座鐘，卻因不同事件而動。方澤看第一座在模型車越過感測器時跳動；乘客還找接待處，第二座仍在計時。

paragraphs.en: The transport agency asked the teams to adopt a new queuing rule. Tang Yue noticed that the behavior of the visitors changed whenever the host praised the contest's 'congress of champions.' She cherished the chance to show a better alternative.
paragraphs.zh: 交通機構要求隊伍採用新的排隊規則。唐悅注意到主持人稱頌「冠軍大會」時，訪客的行為就改變了。她珍惜這次展示替代方案的機會。

paragraphs.en: One clock measured vehicles while the other measured actual walking time.
paragraphs.zh: 一座鐘測車輛，另一座鐘測真實步行時間。

paragraphs.en: A child-sized route used fewer steps but required climbing a steep stair. The decoration above the desk could not silence Fang's conscience. He refused to discourage the slowest participant and argued that the fundamental purpose of the test was safe access. Yu Qian said it would horrify the families to learn they were scored as obstacles.
paragraphs.zh: 兒童尺寸的路少走幾步，卻必須爬陡梯。桌上方的裝飾壓不住方澤的良心。他拒絕讓最慢的參與者洩氣，指出測試的根本目的應是安全通行。俞芊說，家庭若得知自己被評成障礙，必會感到驚恐。

paragraphs.en: The team debated whether scoring speed could justify excluding someone. "I thought the first clock was the rule," Fang admitted. "It is a rule," Tang Yue said, "but not the whole journey."
paragraphs.zh: 小隊討論評分快速是否能合理化排除他人。「我以為第一座鐘就是規則，」方澤承認。「它是一部分規則，」唐悅說，「卻不是整段旅程。」

paragraphs.en: An influential observer watched every interaction as the team tested the entrance. The outcome showed that the primitive counting system recorded feet crossing a line, not people safely reaching the reception desk.
paragraphs.zh: 一位有影響力的觀察員注視小隊測試入口時的每次互動。結果顯示，原始的計數系統記錄的是踏過線的腳步，不是安全抵達接待處的人。

paragraphs.en: Tang asked the attendant to explain the start and finish conditions before they tried the route. He pointed to a line on the floor and then to the far platform, never mentioning the desk. Yu asked a passenger where she thought the journey ended. She pointed at the desk because that was where she could ask for the next connection. Fang added that answer to the timing sheet. On the short stair, Duan found a sign low enough for a child to read but a turn too tight for Mei's equipment case. They left the case closed and measured its outline rather than forcing it onto the steps. Mei offered to carry the signs by the longer line while Tang accompanied the last passenger. Fang recorded each arrival separately. The floor counter clicked twice when one walker stepped back to retrieve a dropped card. Its total now exceeded the number of passengers, though nobody extra had arrived. The attendant repeated the movement himself and confirmed the error. At the desk, Tang compared the actual arrivals with both clocks and the sensor total. Their third seal recognized the discrepancy, not a miraculous new speed. Mei wanted to celebrate the open audit request immediately, but Duan pointed to the four-seal condition in the handbook. Tang laid the three seals in order and asked Fang to record what they had earned and what they still needed.
paragraphs.zh: 唐悅先請職員說明起終點。他指地線與遠月臺，沒提接待處。俞芊問乘客認為旅程在哪結束，她指接待處，因那裡能問下一段轉乘。方澤把回答寫進計時表。短梯邊，段芽找到孩子看得到的低牌，轉彎卻窄到梅嵐工具箱過不去。他們不硬搬，只量關著的箱子輪廓。梅嵐沿長路搬牌，唐悅陪最後乘客，方澤逐人記抵達。有人退一步撿卡，地板計數器響兩次，總數超過人數，卻沒新人到。職員親自重做，證實錯誤。到接待處，唐悅把真抵達人數與兩鐘、感測總數比較。第三枚章認可的是差異，不是神奇速度。梅嵐想立刻慶祝稽核申請解鎖，段芽卻指手冊四章條件。唐悅排好三章，請方澤記清已取得與仍需取得的權利。

paragraphs.en: The timing sheet recorded every passenger's arrival and the movement that had made the floor counter register twice.
paragraphs.zh: 計時表記每位乘客抵達，也記造成地板計數器重算的動作。

paragraphs.en: All passengers arrived; they earned a third review seal and unlocked an audit request. A painted robber chased a witch across a backdrop of mountain scenery. The children enjoyed the scene, but Tang Yue called it shameful that the contest used imaginary terror to distract from an ordinary broken timetable.
paragraphs.zh: 乘客全部到達，取得第三枚複核印章，解鎖稽核申請權。彩繪強盜在山景布幕上追趕女巫。孩子們喜歡這一幕，唐悅卻認為競賽用虛構恐懼轉移人們對錯誤時刻表的注意，十分可恥。

paragraphs.en: The board announced that audit requests must wait until the final round. The team now held three review seals. The handbook required four for a hearing, and the fourth could not be awarded for mere protest. Tang Yue put the stamps beside the measured time sheets. The difference between a public claim and a tested claim was becoming a visible pile of paper.
paragraphs.zh: 公告板卻說複核申請要等最後一輪才處理。小隊如今握有三枚複核印章。手冊規定四枚才能開聽證，第四枚不能只靠抗議取得。唐悅把印章放在時間測量表旁。公眾聲稱與受驗證聲稱的差別，漸漸成為一疊看得見的紙。

questions.question: How does the floor counter count one passenger twice?
options: The passenger signs both clocks before walking.
The passenger steps back to retrieve a dropped card.
The attendant enters a second passenger's name in the ledger.
questions.explanation: 有人退回撿卡，越線動作讓計數器多響一次；職員重做也證實錯誤。

questions.question: What remains necessary after the terminal stage?
options: A private ticket for each person who has already arrived.
The destruction of the original timing sheets.
One more review seal before the team can activate a hearing.
questions.explanation: 轉運站後共三章，手冊須四章才能聽證；稽核申請權不等於已取得聽證資格。

paragraphs.en: The festival's last performance was still playing when Mei Lan began counting stacked chairs. The conductor showed her a work log with one time for the final bow and another for the moment the cleaning crew could actually leave.
paragraphs.zh: 節慶最後演出還在進行，梅嵐已開始數疊好的椅子。指揮給她看工作簿：謝幕一個時間，清潔工真正能離開又是另一個。

paragraphs.en: An anniversary campaign filled the festival street with flags. Its coarse paper banners were falling apart, and the organizers tried to assure the teams that the damage would not complicate the morning route.
paragraphs.zh: 週年紀念宣傳活動讓節慶街掛滿旗幟。粗糙紙製布條已開始破損，主辦者仍向小隊保證，損壞不會使早晨路線更複雜。

paragraphs.en: The official schedule gave visiting performers priority over local staff.
paragraphs.zh: 官方時刻表讓外來表演者優先於在地工作者。

paragraphs.en: A conductor's work log revealed that cleaners needed an extra late bus. The orchestra conductor had tied a cord around his notebook. Mei admired his courageous decision to remain after the show; together they would devise a diligent method for counting the late workers who still needed transport.
paragraphs.zh: 指揮員的工作紀錄顯示清潔人員需要一班末班車。樂團指揮用細繩綁住筆記本。梅嵐佩服他演出後仍留下的勇敢決定；他們將一起設計勤勉細緻的方法，統計還需要交通工具的晚班工人。

paragraphs.en: Mei worried the added bus would consume their budget; Yu Qian asked for a fairer estimate. "A parade ends when the guests leave," Mei said. The conductor corrected her: "For the workers, it ends when the chairs are stacked."
paragraphs.zh: 梅嵐擔憂加班車會耗光預算，俞芊要求更公平的估算。「遊行在賓客離開時結束，」梅嵐說。指揮糾正她：「對工作人員來說，要等椅子疊好才結束。」

paragraphs.en: A display about the old dynasty used foam bricks and played bells at a fixed frequency. Fang's evaluation found that its timetable was an imitation of a historical schedule, not the operating plan for today's staff.
paragraphs.zh: 舊王朝展覽以泡棉磚搭景，按固定頻率敲鐘。方澤評估後發現，展示的時刻表只是模仿歷史班次，並非今日員工真正使用的計畫。

paragraphs.en: Fang drew a line between those times and asked how many workers remained after the visitors' bus departed. The conductor counted musicians first, then stopped when a cleaner pointed to the temporary kitchens. Cooks and stall assistants were still working there. Yu walked to the kitchen entrance with the shift supervisor and asked for totals, leaving personal names out of the route sheet. Tang compared the totals with the bus's seats and the time needed to reach the stop. One worker used a cart to collect cups, so Mei checked where that cart could be stored before boarding. Simply adding a departure time would not help if the only storage gate had already closed. With the organizer's permission, they moved the staff waiting point beside the open service yard. Duan drew a sign showing the new stop and the last boarding time. The conductor asked whether the sign meant the bus would wait indefinitely. Tang added a clear limit and a number for reporting delays. Their trial included the last worker's walk from the kitchen, rather than ending when the first musician sat down. The loop took longer than the public schedule allowed and carried the staff home. At the review table, Mei put the lost points beside the boarding totals. The rival captain approached after the announcement, looking at the totals rather than the bright score above them.
paragraphs.zh: 方澤連兩時刻，問賓客車離開後還有多少員工。指揮先數樂手，清潔工卻指臨時廚房，廚師與攤位助手仍在工作。俞芊和班長走到廚房入口，只問總數，不把私名寫入路線表。唐悅比對座位與走到車站所需時間。一名工人用車收杯，梅嵐先查上車前哪裡能存車；若唯一存放門已關，只加發車時間也無用。經主辦者許可，他們把等候點移到開著的服務院旁。段芽畫新站與最後上車時間。指揮問車是否會無限等候，唐悅加明確限時與通報延誤電話。試走從最後工人離廚房算，不在第一位樂手坐下就結束。循環比公開表長，卻能載員工回家。梅嵐在複核桌把失分與上車總數並列。公告後，競爭隊長走來，看的是總數，不是上方亮分數。

paragraphs.en: The loop drawing now included boarding times for the last workers, with a clear limit on how long the bus would wait.
paragraphs.zh: 循環圖納入最後工人上車時間，也標車輛等待的明確上限。

paragraphs.en: The loop worked but cost points because the score ignored workers' journey home. The volunteer labor office offered water containing mineral salts to the workers. Yu Qian warned that needy families could not rely on good intentions alone; their psychology of travel reflected whether the last bus would actually arrive.
paragraphs.zh: 新路線可行，卻因評分忽略工人的返家路程而扣分。志工勞務辦公室為工人提供含礦物質的飲水。俞芊提醒，困頓家庭不能只靠善意生活；他們對交通的心理感受，反映末班車究竟會不會來。

paragraphs.en: A rival captain quietly asked to compare notes rather than race them.
paragraphs.zh: 競爭隊長私下要求交換紀錄，而不是繼續比快。

questions.question: Why does the festival plan include time after the final bow?
options: The audience must return to watch the performance again.
The conductor needs an extra rehearsal before counting seats.
Cleaners and kitchen workers still have work before boarding.
questions.explanation: 謝幕並非員工下班；清潔與廚房仍工作，試走須算最後工人離場。

questions.question: Why does the working festival loop lose points?
options: The score ignores the workers' journey home.
The team forgets to count any of the musicians.
The late bus is tested with no departure limit.
questions.explanation: 新循環能載員工返家，但原評分沒有計入工人返家需求，因此反而失分。

paragraphs.en: A loaded cart waited below the new bridge, its front wheels pressed against the first rise. Duan Ya crouched beside it and traced the height difference with her pencil while the judge praised the bridge's short line across the artificial gorge.
paragraphs.zh: 載貨車停在新橋下，前輪抵第一道高差。段芽蹲下用鉛筆比高度，評審還在讚美橋跨人工峽谷的短直線。

paragraphs.en: Accuracy mattered more than a competitor's bright diploma pinned to his jacket. Tang Yue told the group to analyze their notes, then adapt the plan to the actual width of the bridge rather than its attractive drawing.
paragraphs.zh: 正確性比競爭者夾在外套上的亮眼文憑更重要。唐悅請大家分析筆記，再依橋梁的真實寬度調整計畫，而不是相信漂亮圖畫。

paragraphs.en: The bridge entrance was high enough to block carts and bicycles.
paragraphs.zh: 橋的入口高得擋住手推車與腳踏車。

paragraphs.en: A survey marked the residents' ordinary transport habits in the margin. Artificial frost covered the rocks, and a toy helicopter circled overhead. A herd of model cattle blocked the lower path. Yu Qian said an intense rush could injure someone even in a controlled contest.
paragraphs.zh: 調查表的邊緣記著居民平常的移動習慣。人工霜覆蓋岩石，玩具直升機在上空盤旋。一群模型牛擋住下方道路。俞芊說，即使在受控競賽中，猛烈衝刺仍可能傷人。

paragraphs.en: Fang preferred strict compliance with the contest instructions; Duan Ya challenged their assumptions. Duan Ya tapped the loaded cart. "If the bridge is for everyone," she wrote, "everyone's ordinary things must fit too."
paragraphs.zh: 方澤傾向嚴守競賽指示，段芽則質疑那些假設。段芽敲敲裝滿物品的推車，寫道：「橋若給所有人用，他們每天帶的東西也得過得去。」

paragraphs.en: A cardboard mule pulled a small cart along the ramp. Mei and the plumber agreed on a mutual test, although Fang first opposed spending another ten minutes. The loaded cart climbed only twenty percent of the suggested slope.
paragraphs.zh: 紙板騾子拖著小推車走上坡道。梅嵐與水管工同意共同測試，儘管方澤起初反對多花十分鐘。載重車只能爬上建議坡度的百分之二十。

paragraphs.en: Mei asked the plumber to hold the cart on level ground before they attempted any slope. The load was ordinary market stock, not a special weight chosen to make the bridge fail. Fang checked the item list against the residents' survey and found that several families also moved bicycles along the old road. The bridge drawing showed walkers without any belongings. Tang asked the judge whether the proposed replacement covered those families or only the empty figures in the drawing. He told them to demonstrate the difference. They began below the rise, with the plumber holding a safety strap and nobody standing behind the cart. The wheels climbed a short distance, then stopped. Mei marked the position without pushing harder. Duan measured how much of the approach remained and sketched the sharp change in level. On the ground route, the same load could move steadily after the model cattle were removed by staff. Yu timed the journey from the same starting point and included the turn into the market. It was longer on the map and easier to complete. Fang had expected strict obedience to protect the team's standing; now he handed the judge both sheets and asked which users the bridge could genuinely serve. The judge checked the starting points before inviting public comments. Tang made space in their log for the district names those comments would bring.
paragraphs.zh: 試坡前，梅嵐請水管工在平地扶車。貨物是普通市場存貨，不是為讓橋失敗特製的重物。方澤把品項與居民調查比對，發現不少家庭也推腳踏車走舊路，橋圖卻只畫空手行人。唐悅問替代方案究竟包含那些家庭，還是只包含圖上的空人形。評審叫他們示範。他們從坡下開始，水管工握安全帶，車後不站人。輪子爬一小段就停，梅嵐不硬推，只標位置。段芽量剩餘坡段，畫突變高差。工作人員移開模型牛後，同樣貨物在地面路能穩穩移動。俞芊從同起點計時，包含轉入市場。圖上較長，卻較能完成。方澤原以為嚴守指示能保名次，現在把兩表交評審，問橋真正服務誰。評審先查起點，再邀公開意見，唐悅在共用簿留地方記它們帶來的街區名。

paragraphs.en: The recorded cart positions showed exactly where the bridge approach failed and where the ground route remained usable.
paragraphs.zh: 推車位置紀錄清楚顯示橋坡在哪失效、地面路哪裡仍可用。

paragraphs.en: A judge approved the measurement, not the proposed bridge, and invited public comments. The reduction in travel speed was slight, yet the change in safety was remarkable. They photographed the surroundings and argued that public welfare meant keeping this everyday route usable, not merely painting a grand bridge.
paragraphs.zh: 評審認可量測結果，卻不核准橋案，改要求公開意見。速度減少的幅度很小，安全性的改善卻很顯著。他們拍下周圍環境，主張公共福祉是維持日常路線可用，而非只把橋畫得氣派。

paragraphs.en: The comments revealed a district that officials had never visited.
paragraphs.zh: 意見揭露有個官員從未踏足的街區。

questions.question: How is the cart test kept relevant to ordinary residents?
options: Its load is checked against the residents' transport survey.
It is filled with special weights chosen to break the bridge.
It begins at the top of the rise with all goods removed.
questions.explanation: 貨物是普通市場存貨，方澤用居民調查核品項，沒有用特製重物製造失敗。

questions.question: What does the judge approve after comparing the bridge and ground route?
options: The bridge as a complete replacement without further questions.
The measurement, followed by an invitation for public comments.
A rule that residents must leave bicycles at home.
questions.explanation: 評審認可量測，未直接核准橋案，改邀公開意見釐清服務對象。

paragraphs.en: Behind the apartment lobby's shining doors, a stroller wheel caught in the closing gap. Yu Qian stopped the empty stroller with her foot and asked the manager to keep the entrance open while the family explained where they needed to go.
paragraphs.zh: 公寓大廳亮門後，嬰兒車輪卡進正在關閉的縫。俞芊用腳擋住空車，請管理員先開著入口，讓家庭說要去哪裡。

paragraphs.en: A portrait of the building owner's ancestor hung in the lobby. Contrary to the brochure, the entrance was not a fine piece of craft: a heavy door could crush a stroller wheel. Yu Qian asked whether calling it defensible made it safe.
paragraphs.zh: 大廳掛著屋主祖先的肖像。與手冊說法相反，入口不是精良工藝：沉重的門可能壓壞嬰兒車輪。俞芊問，稱它合理就代表安全嗎？

paragraphs.en: The published plan assumed every visitor could carry a child up the stairs.
paragraphs.zh: 公布的圖假設所有訪客都能抱孩子上樓。

paragraphs.en: A tenant's handwritten note identified a working service lift behind the kitchen. A distinguished architect had signed the old plan. Staff offered to equip the team with a hose and ladder, but Duan Ya felt guilt about testing without permission. The architect's handwriting on the approved sheet clearly required an accessible lift.
paragraphs.zh: 房客的手寫便條指出廚房後方有一部可運作的服務電梯。一位知名建築師曾在舊圖簽名。人員願提供水管和梯子等裝備，段芽卻因未先取得許可而感到不安。核准表上建築師的筆跡清楚要求設置無障礙電梯。

paragraphs.en: Yu Qian insisted on asking residents what they needed instead of assigning a universal route. "Ask the families," Yu Qian said. "A drawing cannot tell us whether waiting twenty minutes with a child feels safe."
paragraphs.zh: 俞芊堅持詢問住戶需求，而非替所有人安排單一路線。「問問家庭吧，」俞芊說，「一張圖不會告訴我們，帶著孩子等二十分鐘是否安心。」

paragraphs.en: The doors were identical, and an invitation to launch a guided tour did not involve actual residents. Mei called the invitation lousy, while Fang apologized for having misunderstood the tenant's concerns about waiting in the corridor.
paragraphs.zh: 每扇門都一模一樣。邀請書要他們推出導覽，卻沒有讓真正住戶參與。梅嵐認為邀請很糟，方澤則為自己誤解住戶對走廊等待的擔憂道歉。

paragraphs.en: The family wanted the nursery first and the clinic afterward. The printed tour route led to the clinic and then back upstairs, with no place to leave the stroller. Duan copied the two destinations in the family's chosen order. The tenant's note sent them toward the kitchen, where a service lift was waiting behind a plain door. Mei checked its posted capacity with the technician before putting anything inside. The group used an empty stroller and bags to test the space, leaving the child with a parent in the lobby. Fang timed the doors opening, loading, travel, and return; he had first planned to time only the upward journey. When a second stroller reached the landing, they discovered why that would be misleading. One family would have to wait through another cycle. Yu asked the parents where that wait would feel manageable. They chose a bench visible from the nursery desk rather than a blank corridor by the kitchen. Tang requested permission to mark the waiting point on the public map. The manager offered a guided escort instead, but the families wanted a route they could use without arranging a tour. Duan added the lift's capacity and the expected cycle time in large writing. Their map now showed a usable journey with a real wait, rather than a promise that every door would open immediately for every visitor.
paragraphs.zh: 他們想先托育、再診所，印好的導覽線卻先診所再折返樓上，沒有存車處。段芽按家庭選的順序記目的地。房客便條把他們引向廚房，素門後有服務電梯。梅嵐先和技師查標示載量，才放東西。小隊用空車與袋測空間，孩子留大廳由家長照顧。方澤量開門、裝載、行駛與回程；原本只想量上行，第二輛車來時才明白那會誤導：另一家須再等一輪。俞芊問哪裡等比較能接受，家長選托育櫃檯看得到的長椅，不選廚房旁空走廊。唐悅請准在公共圖標等待點。管理員提議派導覽陪同，家庭要的卻是不必預約導覽也能走的路。段芽用大字寫載量與預期週期。地圖呈現可行但需等候的旅程，不再承諾每扇門都會立即為每位來客開。

paragraphs.en: Duan's revised family route included permission for the lift test, its limited capacity, and the full cycle time.
paragraphs.zh: 段芽的家庭修正版包含電梯試用許可、有限載量與完整週期。

paragraphs.en: Their plan reduced strain but required honest warnings about waiting times. A notice about pregnancy care listed clinic hours beside a difficult riddle for visitors. Yu Qian made a simple suggestion: ask the technician to measure the lift cycle. With one stroke of her pencil, Duan Ya replaced the impossible shortcut on their map.
paragraphs.zh: 規劃降低負擔，卻必須誠實警示等候時間。孕期照護公告寫著診所開放時間，旁邊竟設有難解謎題。俞芊提出簡單建議：請技術員量測電梯往返時間。段芽一筆劃掉地圖上不可行的捷徑。

paragraphs.en: The tower manager claimed a perfect score despite not meeting a single resident.
paragraphs.zh: 大樓管理員宣稱自己得到滿分，卻沒和一位住戶談過話。

questions.question: Why does Fang include the lift's return cycle in his timing?
options: The service lift cannot carry any objects upward.
A second stroller must wait until the lift returns.
The nursery desk is open only during downward travel.
questions.explanation: 第二輛車到時得等下一輪，因此只量上行會低估真正等待。

questions.question: What warning must accompany the improved family route?
options: A claim that every visitor will enter the lift immediately.
An instruction requiring every parent to carry a stroller upstairs.
The lift's limited capacity and expected waiting time.
questions.explanation: 路線降低抱行負擔，卻須標載量與週期，誠實說明等候。

paragraphs.en: Fang found the carbon copy by following the line of rust beneath the ticket window. The paper was still held under the old frame, so he asked Mei to support the frame before anyone tried to draw it out.
paragraphs.zh: 方澤沿售票窗下的鏽線找到複寫紙，紙仍壓在舊框下。他先請梅嵐支框，沒讓人直接抽紙。

paragraphs.en: An association of former rail workers had stored an autobiography by a bald stationmaster. Tang Yue's curiosity arose because the book described a timetable revision, and a consequent loss of late-night service, in precise dates.
paragraphs.zh: 前鐵路工人協會保存了一本禿頭站長的自傳。唐悅因此產生好奇：書中以明確日期描述某次時刻表更改，以及隨之失去的夜間服務。

paragraphs.en: New machine labels had covered dates on the original paper notices.
paragraphs.zh: 新的機器標籤蓋住原本公告的日期。

paragraphs.en: Under a rusty frame, Fang discovered a carbon copy with a different approval number. A resident declared that she was dependent on the last train. Beside the closed fireplace, an old forecast predicted high passenger numbers; Fang explained that the prediction was not proof of where people had actually traveled.
paragraphs.zh: 方澤在生鏽框架下找到一張核准編號不同的複寫紙。居民宣告自己依賴末班列車。封住的壁爐旁，一份舊預測說乘客會很多；方澤解釋，預測不是人們實際去向的證據。

paragraphs.en: Tang Yue refused to accuse a named official without checking the copy's origin. "We know a label was replaced," Fang said. "We do not yet know who chose to replace it. Keep those facts separate."
paragraphs.zh: 唐悅拒絕在查明複本來源前指控具名官員。「我們知道標籤被換掉，」方澤說，「卻還不知道誰決定換。這兩件事必須分開。」

paragraphs.en: At a pretend café, a sign offered lobster pasta. The station machinery halted without warning, and an actor playing a minister demanded that customers move aside. Mei asked whether the scene was theater or an official test.
paragraphs.zh: 模擬咖啡館的牌子寫著龍蝦義大利麵。車站機械毫無預警停下，飾演部長的演員要求顧客讓路。梅嵐問，這究竟是戲劇還是正式測試。

paragraphs.en: The station attendant brought a shallow tray and watched them photograph the copy in place. Tang asked which office had stored it and whether the frame had been opened since the timetable changed. The attendant could answer the first question but not the second. Fang wrote both responses beside the image number. On the copy, a faint approval digit could be read in two ways. Duan held a blank card beside it to block the sunset lamp's glare, revealing a broken curve rather than a straight stroke. They compared it with the approval register instead of guessing from its resemblance to a familiar number. The register confirmed an earlier version with the late service still listed. Yu asked the resident who depended on that service whether she wanted her name included in their challenge. She preferred a description of the missed connection, and they used that. A mechanical announcement interrupted the comparison when the station display stopped. Mei checked with the attendant that the interruption was part of the stage, then waited for safe permission to resume. Their submission included the original image, the later notice, and a page identifying the remaining uncertainty about who changed it. When the premium-route pass was withdrawn, Tang requested a receipt for that decision as carefully as she had requested one for the evidence. The anonymous warning arrived folded inside the returned pass sleeve.
paragraphs.zh: 站務員拿淺盤，見證原位拍照。唐悅問哪個辦公室保管、時刻表變動後框是否開過；職員能答前者，不能答後者。方澤把兩項回應並列影號。複本一個淡數字有兩種讀法，段芽在旁舉白卡擋模擬夕陽反光，才看出斷曲線而非直筆。他們查核准簿，不靠猜像哪個熟悉數字。簿證實較早版本仍列晚班。俞芊問依靠晚車的居民是否願在異議書具名，她只想描述錯過轉乘，眾人照辦。車站展示忽然停機，廣播打斷比對。梅嵐先問職員是否是關卡安排，再等安全准許恢復。呈件包含原影像、新公告，以及仍不確定誰修改的說明。快速線通行證被收回時，唐悅對這項決定也像交證一樣要求收據。匿名警告摺在退還的證套裡。

paragraphs.en: Fang numbered the print comparisons and the missing-signature note before staff signed for custody of the copied evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 方澤替印痕比較和缺簽註記編號，再由職員簽收副本保管。

paragraphs.en: The station accepted their written challenge but removed their access to the premium route. A quotation from the original timetable helped restore the missing sequence of stops. The paper was rusty around its metal clip, but it showed no vacancy in the late shift. Fang said altering its date would violate the archive rule.
paragraphs.zh: 車站接受書面異議，卻取消他們進入快速路線的權限。原始時刻表中的引文幫助他們還原遺失的停靠順序。紙張邊的金屬夾生鏽，仍顯示夜班並無缺額。方澤說，更改日期就違反檔案規定。

paragraphs.en: Someone left an anonymous message claiming that the scoring office was not independent.
paragraphs.zh: 有人留下匿名訊息，指稱評分辦公室並不獨立。

questions.question: How does the team resolve the faint approval digit on the carbon copy?
options: It asks the anonymous sender to choose the most likely number.
It replaces the faint mark with the later notice's date.
It blocks the glare and compares the digit with the approval register.
questions.explanation: 段芽用白卡擋反光，看清筆形後，再查核准簿確認較早版本。

questions.question: What happens after the station accepts the written challenge?
options: The team loses access to the premium route.
The station names the official responsible for the alteration.
The late train is restored immediately by the contest staff.
questions.explanation: 書面異議獲收件，但快速路線權限被取消；責任人與恢復班次都尚未確定。

paragraphs.en: The publisher's wall was barely wide enough for three journeys side by side. Duan measured it with chalk on her fingers while Tang Yue asked which details the participants had allowed the team to show in public.
paragraphs.zh: 出版人的牆剛夠並列三段旅程。段芽滿手粉筆量寬，唐悅則問參與者准許公開哪些細節。

paragraphs.en: The commission spoke of acceptance and an ambitious future in a cheerful atmosphere. Tang Yue asked for an authentic list of test journeys, because officials must classify real outcomes rather than applause from the crowd.
paragraphs.zh: 委員會在歡樂氣氛中談論接受結果與雄心勃勃的未來。唐悅要求提供真實的測試旅程清單，因為官員必須分類實際結果，而不是觀眾掌聲。

paragraphs.en: Official staff tried to remove the team's handwritten calculations.
paragraphs.zh: 工作人員試圖移除小隊的手寫計算。

paragraphs.en: A school publisher offered a blank wall for a public comparison chart. Two routes differed in length, but both had to protect each traveler's dignity. Fang tried not to embarrass the facility manager when he found a genuine mistake in the count, and let her inspect the figures beside him.
paragraphs.zh: 一位學校出版人願意提供空牆展示公開比較圖。兩條路長度不同，卻都必須維護每名旅客的尊嚴。方澤發現設施管理員確實算錯時，不願讓她難堪，便請她一起核對數字。

paragraphs.en: The group debated whether public criticism could embarrass those who made honest mistakes. An audience member called out, "So which team wins?" Tang Yue answered, "First, show me which families can actually arrive."
paragraphs.zh: 小隊討論公開批評是否會讓誠實犯錯者受辱。觀眾喊：「那到底哪隊贏？」唐悅回答：「先讓我看看哪些家庭真的能抵達。」

paragraphs.en: A poster used an offensive joke to promote a luxury option; the perfume shop next door had paid for the promotion. A local publisher offered them wall space for a clearer display without the insulting language.
paragraphs.zh: 海報用冒犯性的笑話宣傳豪華選項；旁邊香水店付了促銷費。當地出版商願讓小隊使用牆面，展示不含侮辱性語言的清楚資料。

paragraphs.en: One family agreed to share its waiting time but not the clinic it had visited. Fang replaced the destination name with a plain symbol and kept the original in the protected notebook. Mei drew the first journey as a continuous line, then stopped when Yu pointed out that the family had spent part of it standing still. They added separate blocks for walking, waiting, and asking for directions. A spectator who had praised the fastest team asked why one line was so much longer. Tang invited him to follow the blocks with his finger. He reached the wait at the lift and understood that the person had not simply chosen to walk slowly. The facility manager found a copied total that did not match the blocks. Fang checked it beside her and corrected the sum in chalk, leaving a small note showing what changed. That made the chart look less polished and easier to trust. When staff approached to remove the calculations, the publisher showed his permission for the wall. Tang moved the protected notebook into her bag and left the public figures visible. The petition began with a request to repeat the three journeys, rather than a demand to declare her team the winner. By the time the commissioners agreed to hear evidence, the chalk was wearing from visitors tracing the routes, and Mei had begun making a paper copy that would survive the evening cleaning.
paragraphs.zh: 一家同意分享等候時間，不公開所去診所。方澤把地名換普通符號，原件留受保護簿。梅嵐先畫連線，俞芊指出其中一段人其實站著，她才停筆，分畫步行、等候、問路區塊。一名讚最快隊的觀眾問為何有線特長，唐悅請他用手指跟著走。到電梯等待格，他明白那人並非選擇慢走。設施管理員發現抄來總數與區塊不合，方澤和她一起核，粉筆改算式，留註記說明變更。圖較不光鮮，卻更能信任。職員走來要移除計算，出版人出示牆面許可。唐悅收好私簿，留下公數。請願先要求重走三程，不要求宣布己隊冠軍。委員答應聽證時，粉筆已被訪客描路磨淡，梅嵐開始抄紙本，好在晚間清掃後仍保得住。

paragraphs.en: Their public chart displayed three test journeys with walking and waiting separated, while the private source pages stayed protected.
paragraphs.zh: 公圖分開三程的步行與等待，私來源頁仍受保護。

paragraphs.en: The audience signed an independent petition and the commissioners agreed to hear evidence. A refugee family in the simulation requested a rescue path for their grandmother. An actor's resignation letter hung beside a row of Christmas stockings. Tang Yue wanted to transform these personal stories into usable access records, not dramatic decorations.
paragraphs.zh: 觀眾簽署獨立請願，委員同意聽取證據。模擬情境中的難民家庭要求一條協助祖母撤離的路線。演員的辭職信掛在一排聖誕襪旁。唐悅希望把這些人的故事轉化為可用的通行紀錄，而非戲劇裝飾。

paragraphs.en: The city's contract required an evaluation before the hearing could change anything. The comparison chart earned the team its fourth review seal. Fang checked every stamp against the registration handbook; the hearing clause was real, but the office would hear them only after the next batch of tests. That delay angered Mei, who nevertheless agreed to preserve the evidence rather than stage an empty victory.
paragraphs.zh: 城市合約規定，聽證會若要改變結果，必須先進行評估。比較圖讓小隊取得第四枚複核印章。方澤依報名手冊核對每枚印章；聽證條款確實存在，但辦公室要求下批測試後才受理。這個拖延讓梅嵐生氣，她仍同意保存證據，而非宣告空洞的勝利。

questions.question: Why are walking and waiting shown as separate blocks on the chart?
options: They reveal where time is lost without assuming a traveler chose to walk slowly.
They allow the team to publish the family's private clinic name.
They ensure every journey appears to take exactly the same time.
questions.explanation: 把等待分出，觀眾能看到電梯等候等原因，不把整段延誤都歸為慢走。

questions.question: What does the public petition initially request?
options: That Tang's team be named the winner without another test.
That the three documented journeys be repeated and examined.
That the facility manager's private records be displayed on the wall.
questions.explanation: 請願要求重走三段已記錄旅程，並非跳過驗證直接宣布小隊勝利。

paragraphs.en: Mei's sleeve snapped against the tower rail before the wind instrument reached its marked limit. She stepped back to the sheltered observation point, and Tang Yue asked the director to keep the upper walkway empty while they checked the readings.
paragraphs.zh: 風速儀還未到標線，梅嵐袖子已啪地撞欄。她退回遮蔽觀察點，唐悅請主任保持上層步道無人，先查讀數。

paragraphs.en: Fang would not accuse the contractor before checking the tower logs. Its director gave an assurance that the route was safe and began to boast about rising commerce; Tang Yue asked for consistent wind readings instead of a sales speech.
paragraphs.zh: 方澤在核實大樓日誌前不願指控承包商。主任保證路線安全，又開始誇耀商業繁榮；唐悅要求一致的風速讀數，而不是推銷演說。

paragraphs.en: The speed calculation ignored wind exposure along the upper walkway.
paragraphs.zh: 速度計算忽略上層步道的風力暴露。

paragraphs.en: An old manufacturing label supplied the tower's original safety limit. A builders' convention offered to contribute instruments for the test. One display described how a hurricane could expose weak walls, while another promoted hydrogen-powered equipment. Mei insisted that impressive technology did not replace basic safety measurements.
paragraphs.zh: 一張舊製造標籤提供大樓原始安全限制。建築業年會願捐助測試儀器。一面展示板說颶風可能暴露脆弱牆體，另一面介紹氫能設備。梅嵐堅持，再先進的科技也不能取代基本安全量測。

paragraphs.en: Fang said the evidence might discredit their own earlier estimates; Tang Yue agreed to publish it anyway. "The wind doesn't read the scoreboard," Mei told the tower manager. "Why should our report pretend it does?"
paragraphs.zh: 方澤說證據可能推翻他們之前的估算，唐悅仍同意公開。「風不會讀計分板，」梅嵐對大樓主管說，「我們的報告又為什麼要假裝它會？」

paragraphs.en: Calling residents ignorant would display the contractor's own ignorance, Yu Qian said. She wanted an informative notice that remained loyal to the people who had reported problems. A manufacture date on a railing revealed an earlier misfortune: one support had been replaced after a storm.
paragraphs.zh: 俞芊說，稱居民無知只會暴露承包商自己的無知。她要的是有資訊、有誠意且忠於通報者的公告。欄杆上的製造日期揭露一次過去事故：有根支柱曾在風災後更換。

paragraphs.en: Fang found that his earlier estimate had used a calm-weather journey from the sheltered side. He set it beside the tower log and circled the difference in location. The director offered to discard the old estimate quietly; Fang asked that it remain attached to the corrected report. Duan drew the observation points so later readers could see why the two sets differed. The technician showed them the instrument's scale and its last inspection date. From behind the barrier, they took readings at fixed intervals rather than walking into stronger gusts to prove a point. Yu wrote down when a visitor would have to stop and where that person could wait without blocking the next arrival. A stronger piece of glass on the neighboring tower did not tell them whether this walkway was safe, so Mei kept that comparison in a separate note. She checked the replaced rail support against its maintenance entry instead. By the final interval, the table showed several conditions under which their original travel time would be unrealistic. Tang put those conditions at the front of the report. The director could still argue for his route, but the conditions would travel with the numbers. At the review desk, the commission accepted the record without promising new scores. While Fang waited for its receipt, the technician asked whether he knew that the scoreboard's figures came from another company entirely.
paragraphs.zh: 方澤發現先前估算用的是無風時、遮蔽側旅程。他把估算與大樓簿並排，圈出位置差。主任願悄悄丟舊值，方澤要求附在修正報告。段芽畫觀測點，讓後來讀者知道兩組為何不同。技師展示儀器刻度與末次檢查日期。眾人在障礙後定時讀數，不走進強陣風證明勇敢。俞芊記何時訪客須停、哪裡可等而不擋來者。鄰棟強玻璃不能證明本步道安全，梅嵐把比較另註，再核換過的欄柱與維修項。末次讀數前，表已列出多種讓原旅時不實際的條件。唐悅把條件放報告首頁。主任仍可支持路線，條件卻須跟著數字。複核桌收紀錄，不保證新分數。方澤等收據時，技師問他可知計分板數值其實來自另一家公司。

paragraphs.en: The tower report identified each sheltered observation point and retained the earlier estimate beside the corrected wind readings.
paragraphs.zh: 高樓報告標每個遮蔽觀測點，讓舊估算與修正風讀值並存。

paragraphs.en: The commission admitted the record yet offered no assurance about future scoring. A troublesome elevator slowed the test, but a recovery crew offered a quiet room for relaxation between attempts. Tang Yue noted the resistance of the high windows and compared it with the neighboring skyscraper, where stronger glass had been installed.
paragraphs.zh: 委員會承認紀錄，卻不保證日後會修改評分。麻煩的電梯拖慢測試，復原小組提供安靜房間讓大家在測試之間休息。唐悅記下高窗承受的阻力，與鄰近裝設強化玻璃的摩天樓比較。

paragraphs.en: A technician revealed that the scoreboard received scores from a separate contractor.
paragraphs.zh: 技術員透露計分板的分數來自另一家承包商。

questions.question: Why does Fang keep his earlier calm-weather estimate in the report?
options: The director requires all strong-wind readings to be discarded.
It shows why the corrected wind-related estimate differs.
The earlier estimate proves the upper walkway is always safe.
questions.explanation: 早估算來自遮蔽側且天氣不同；保留並標地點差，讀者才懂修正原因。

questions.question: What does the commission promise when it accepts the tower record?
options: It guarantees the team first place in every later stage.
It grants permission to test the walkway in any wind.
It accepts the evidence without assuring a change in future scoring.
questions.explanation: 委員會收下風力紀錄，卻沒有保證改評分，更非解除安全限制。

paragraphs.en: A thin ring of water had reached the oval tank's base when Yu Qian tested the dry rail with her palm. The nearest path still looked clear, but the maintenance record described what happened when a pump stopped.
paragraphs.zh: 橢圓槽底已圍一薄圈水，俞芊用掌試乾扶手。最近路看似仍通，維修簿卻描述抽水機停轉後的情況。

paragraphs.en: The rule demanded absolute safety and steady discipline, but the water distribution board rewarded only efficiency. Yu Qian admitted she felt dread when the shortest corridor passed a rising tank without a railing.
paragraphs.zh: 規則要求絕對安全和穩定紀律，供水分配看板卻只獎勵效率。俞芊坦承，一條沒有扶手的最短通道貼著上升的水槽，讓她感到恐懼。

paragraphs.en: The official path was shortest only when the pumps ran perfectly.
paragraphs.zh: 官方路線只有在抽水機完美運作時才最短。

paragraphs.en: An illustrated maintenance record identified a backup vessel used during outages. Mei used spare hardware to fasten a loose guard, thanking a gracious volunteer for holding the light. On the wall, a small painting showed a hawk above a river; the artist's note described the grief caused by an old flood.
paragraphs.zh: 圖解維護紀錄指出停機時會用到的備用槽。梅嵐用備用五金固定鬆動護欄，並感謝一位親切志工幫忙照明。牆上小畫畫著河上的老鷹，藝術家的說明提到一次舊洪水造成的悲傷。

paragraphs.en: Mei wanted to rush across before the water rose; Yu Qian warned that haste hid risk. Yu Qian touched the dry rail. "A fast route that works only on perfect days isn't an emergency route," she said.
paragraphs.zh: 梅嵐想趁水位升高前衝過去，俞芊提醒急躁會掩蓋風險。俞芊摸著乾燥扶手說：「只在完美日子才有用的快速路線，不是緊急路線。」

paragraphs.en: A clear illustration showed a miner carrying an oval vessel through the tunnel. Fang wanted to insert the drawing into their report but cautioned that the picture's perfection did not prove the real corridor was open.
paragraphs.zh: 一張清晰插畫畫著礦工扛著橢圓形容器穿過隧道。方澤想把圖插入報告，卻提醒大家，圖畫完美不代表真實走廊可以通行。

paragraphs.en: Tang asked the operator to explain how the controlled outage would end before anyone entered the room. He showed the switch and the marked water limit. Mei secured the loose fitting from the dry side, with a volunteer holding the light where she requested. They did not turn off a real public pump; the training tank had its own isolated controls. Fang copied that limit into the report so nobody would mistake their trial for permission to interfere with city water. When the training pump paused, a shallow sheet spread across the short corridor. Duan marked its edge from behind the barrier and compared it with the backup vessel's illustrated position. The longer line stayed dry, but the vessel's handle projected into the walking space. Mei asked the operator to move it to the approved place before they measured that route. Yu walked once at her own pace and asked a second volunteer to try without hearing her directions. The volunteer hesitated at an old arrow pointing toward the wet floor. Tang replaced it with a temporary warning after receiving permission, and Duan noted the change on the sketch. Their final time included the pause to read that warning. When the water was drained, Fang checked the maintenance page's supplier entry for their source list. Its name matched the scoring contractor's, a connection he recorded without yet claiming what it meant.
paragraphs.zh: 入室前，唐悅請操作員說清受控停機如何結束。他指開關與限水線。梅嵐在乾側固定鬆接件，志工按她指的位置照燈。不是關真公共泵，訓練槽有獨立控制；方澤把限制抄入報告，免被誤作可干預城市供水的許可。訓練泵暫停，淺水鋪過短廊。段芽站障礙後標水邊，比備用槽圖示。長線仍乾，槽把手卻伸入步行空間。梅嵐請操作員先移到核准位才量。俞芊照自己步速走一次，再請不先聽她指示的志工試。那人停在指濕地的舊箭頭前。唐悅獲准換臨時警示，段芽註記改動。最後計時包含讀警示的停頓。排水後，方澤整理來源表，注意到維修頁供應商與評分承包商同名；他記連結，沒有先斷定含意。

paragraphs.en: The dry-route drawing showed the secured fittings, measured water edge, moved vessel, and replacement warning.
paragraphs.zh: 乾路圖標出固定接件、水邊量測、移動容器與新警告。

paragraphs.en: The safe route succeeded and its evidence became part of the public review file. The revised plan was realistic and earned recognition from the inspector. Tang Yue resolved to renew the wet-floor warning, while Mei carefully moved the backup vessel to its approved place outside the walking line.
paragraphs.zh: 安全路線成功，證據納入公開複核檔案。修改後的方案務實可行，得到檢查員認可。唐悅決心更新濕滑地板警示，梅嵐小心把備用容器移到步行線外的核准位置。

paragraphs.en: The file unexpectedly listed a supplier with the same name as the scoring contractor.
paragraphs.zh: 檔案意外列出一家與評分承包商同名的供應商。

questions.question: What keeps the pump-outage test from interfering with public water?
options: The team drains the mountain reservoir before beginning.
The backup vessel replaces every pipe in the city.
The training tank has isolated controls.
questions.explanation: 測試使用有獨立控制的訓練槽，並非關真公共泵；報告也註明限制。

questions.question: What becomes part of the public review file after the reservoir stage?
options: Evidence for the successfully tested dry route.
A promise that the shortest wet corridor is always usable.
An order to remove every water-depth warning.
questions.explanation: 安全乾路測試成功，其量測與修正警示等證據納入公開複核檔。

title: The Story Painted on the Wall

paragraphs.en: The alley's painted founder held a golden key above a doorway nobody was using. Tang Yue waited while an elderly volunteer unfolded a sketch showing that same wall before the mural had turned its service entrance into part of the picture.
paragraphs.zh: 巷裡壁畫的創辦人舉金鑰匙，腳下門口卻沒人使用。年長志工展開草圖，唐悅等她攤平：圖上是壁畫把服務入口畫進故事之前的同一面牆。

paragraphs.en: A cherry blossom hung over the table where they would appoint a speaker for the neighborhood conference. Children sang a chorus nearby, while an elder joked that losing old routes felt like a curse. The legends on the wall offered no directions to the service door.
paragraphs.zh: 櫻花懸在會議桌上方，他們將在此指派社區會議發言人。孩子在附近合唱，長者開玩笑說，失去老路線簡直像受了詛咒。牆上的傳說並未提供服務門的方向。

paragraphs.en: A famous mural hid the entrance used by ordinary service workers.
paragraphs.zh: 著名壁畫遮住一般工作人員使用的入口。

paragraphs.en: An elderly volunteer had kept sketches of the old route across generations. The mural's legend praised a wealthy founder, but economics explained who could afford to use the old street. A stone foundation remained below the paint. Duan Ya asked whether the new plan would fulfill the needs of the next generation.
paragraphs.zh: 一位年長志工保存了跨世代的舊路線草圖。壁畫傳說稱頌富有的創辦人，經濟條件卻解釋了誰用得起舊街。塗料下仍留有石製地基。段芽問，新計畫能否滿足下一代需求。

paragraphs.en: Duan Ya said memory could be evidence but not a substitute for a current measurement. "The mural remembered the mayor," Duan Ya wrote, "but the workers remembered the door. We need both records, not just the prettier one."
paragraphs.zh: 段芽說記憶可以是證據，卻不能取代現場量測。段芽寫道：「壁畫記得市長，工人記得那扇門。我們需要兩種紀錄，不只是漂亮的一種。」

paragraphs.en: The volunteer had walked the lane at a leisurely pace for years. Her memorable stories mixed miserable winters with the smell of fresh bread. Tang Yue's proposal was to verify the exit and oxygen vents, not to replace measurements with nostalgia.
paragraphs.zh: 志工多年來總以悠閒步調走過小巷。她難忘的故事既有悲慘寒冬，也有新鮮麵包香。唐悅提議檢查出口和氧氣通風口，而不是用懷舊取代量測。

paragraphs.en: Duan laid the sketch beside a current photograph and looked for features that had not moved. A stone corner and the lower vent aligned; the painted key did not belong to the old drawing at all. Mei asked the attendant to show them the door's hinges rather than trying to pull on the painted surface. The attendant opened a side curtain and revealed a handle covered by an exhibition panel. Moving the panel required permission from the gallery keeper, who feared damaging the mural. Tang asked whether they could first mark the doorway on a temporary transparent sheet. That let the keeper see the proposed change without touching the paint. Yu checked the space behind the door and found that a stack of empty display boxes narrowed the exit. Staff moved the boxes while the team measured from the alley to the next public path. The elderly volunteer wanted them to include the bakery from her childhood. Fang marked it as a remembered landmark because it was no longer there. Her route remained useful without pretending every old shop survived. Once the door opened fully, Duan updated the current map and attached the earlier sketch as a source. The keeper brought an old district rule from the same drawer. Tang read its restriction on excluding low-scoring residents, then asked for a dated copy instead of treating the mural's missing entrance as the whole story.
paragraphs.zh: 段芽把草圖與新照並排，找沒移的特徵。石角與下方通風口吻合，金鑰匙根本不在舊圖。梅嵐請管理員展示門鉸，不硬拉畫面。對方掀側幕，露出被展板遮住的把手。移板需館方許可，保管者怕傷壁畫。唐悅先提議在透明片標門口，讓對方不碰油漆也看懂改法。俞芊查門後，空展示箱把出口弄窄。職員搬箱，小隊量從巷口到下一公共路。志工想加入童年麵包店，方澤標「記憶地標」，因店已不在。她的路仍有用，不須假裝舊店全存。門全開後，段芽更新現圖，附早年草圖為來源。保管者從同抽屜拿舊街區規則。唐悅讀禁止排除低分居民的條文，要求註日期副本，不把一扇消失入口當成整個故事。

paragraphs.en: The current alley map identified the restored entrance and kept the earlier sketches available as separately dated sources.
paragraphs.zh: 現巷圖標恢復入口，較早草圖各註日期、另作來源。

paragraphs.en: The exit opened, proving that the map had erased a practical route rather than a myth. They could scarcely see an old sketch behind the mural's striped curtain. Fang copied each stripe's position, then asked Mei to summarize the evidence. The point was universal access, not a private tour for a few invited guests.
paragraphs.zh: 出口開啟，證明地圖抹去的是實用道路，而非神話。條紋布幕後的舊草圖幾乎看不清楚。方澤逐一記下條紋位置，請梅嵐總結證據。他們要的是普遍通行權，而非少數受邀者的私人導覽。

paragraphs.en: An old document mentioned a citywide rule against excluding low-scoring residents.
paragraphs.zh: 一份舊文件提及不得排除低分居民的全市規則。

questions.question: How does the team compare the old sketch with the current alley?
options: It aligns unchanged features such as the stone corner and lower vent.
It assumes the painted golden key marks the old bakery.
It replaces the current measurements with the volunteer's memories.
questions.explanation: 段芽找石角、下通風口等未變特徵對位；記憶仍與現場量測分開。

questions.question: What does opening the concealed door demonstrate?
options: Every shop remembered by the volunteer is still operating.
The map had omitted a practical service route.
The founder's legend accurately describes all current access.
questions.explanation: 移展板、清箱並實量後門能全開，證明被漏的是實用路，不只是傳說。

paragraphs.en: The express gate took payment before a traveler could see the queue beyond it. Fang watched the shared time-token display fall while a small trader counted the parcels she still had to deliver through the public street.
paragraphs.zh: 快速門在人看見後方隊伍前就收錢。方澤看共享時間代幣顯示下降，一名小販仍在數必須走公共街送的包裹。

paragraphs.en: Their acquaintance at the shopping street gave them access to the express gate. A competitive vendor took an aggressive tone about possible delays; Tang Yue felt ashamed that the team had never asked small traders how their deliveries worked.
paragraphs.zh: 購物街的熟人讓他們進入快速門。一位競爭激烈的商販激動地談起可能的延誤；唐悅對小隊之前從未詢問小商家送貨流程感到慚愧。

paragraphs.en: The express pass drained shared time tokens from teams that could not afford it.
paragraphs.zh: 快速通行證讓付不起費用的隊伍損失共享時間代幣。

paragraphs.en: The original fee formula counted transactions but not the cost of exclusion. The council exhibit offered a neat formula for the city's economy. Fang welcomed criticism of his figures but said a public rule had to include people who could not purchase fast tickets.
paragraphs.zh: 原始費率公式只計交易，未計排除他人的代價。議會展覽提出一條整齊的城市經濟公式。方澤歡迎對數字的批評，卻指出公共規則必須把買不起快速票的人算進去。

paragraphs.en: A shop owner defended the service; Fang asked for a fair alternative that would keep small businesses open. The shopkeeper asked, "Will your fair plan close my store?" Tang Yue replied, "That is why we have to count your deliveries too." The shopkeeper asked whether rewarding quick deliveries could help a small store without charging every slow walker.
paragraphs.zh: 店主替服務辯護，方澤要求既公平又能讓小店營業的替代方案。店主問：「你們的公平方案會讓我關店嗎？」唐悅回答：「所以我們也必須把你的送貨算進去。」店主問，能否獎勵快速送貨幫助小店，卻不向每名慢行者收費。

paragraphs.en: A keen shopkeeper had immigrated years earlier and understood the cost of starting over. 'Moreover,' she said, 'you cannot hasten every customer with a fee.' The current penalty charged slower travelers for using the only public passage.
paragraphs.zh: 熱心又敏銳的店主多年前移居此地，明白重新起步的代價。「再者，」她說，「你不能靠收費就催快每位顧客。」現行罰則竟向使用唯一公共通道的慢行者收錢。

paragraphs.en: Tang asked the trader to describe a normal delivery round without naming her customers. It included a paid crossing, two handovers, and a return for an empty box. The contractor's formula counted the first transaction and ignored the other work. Mei drew separate piles of tokens for the trader and for walkers who could not buy the pass. When the gate gave one group priority, the public line waited even if its members had arrived first. Yu asked the attendant to explain that waiting rule aloud so each observer knew what the test included. They ran the same delivery list under two approved fee arrangements, keeping the load and starting point unchanged. Duan recorded the times at both ends, where the express sign could no longer hide the public queue. The reduced fee did not make every journey faster, but it left fewer people unable to begin the crossing at all. Fang added the trader's return trip before comparing totals. A reward envelope arrived while he was checking that last number. It was addressed to the team captain, with a note praising cooperation. Tang asked whether accepting it required them to stop examining the citywide formula. The messenger could not answer. She returned the envelope unopened and requested the proposal in writing. The judge could examine the reduced-fee plan on its figures, and the small trader could still see her actual deliveries represented on the page.
paragraphs.zh: 唐悅請她不具名客戶，只描述普通送貨圈：付費通行、兩次轉手、再回取空箱。承包商公式只數首筆交易，不數其他工作。梅嵐替小販與買不起票的步行者分畫代幣堆。門給一組優先，公共隊即使先到也得等。俞芊請職員大聲說等待規則，讓觀察員知道測什麼。他們用同貨單試兩種核准費率，載量起點不變；段芽在兩端記時，快線牌再也遮不住公共隊。降費不讓每程都快，卻減少根本無法開始通行的人。方澤加上小販回程才比總數。核最後數字時，送來寫給隊長的獎金信封，附讚合作的紙。唐悅問收下是否須停止查全市公式，送信人答不出。她不拆，退回並要求書面提案。評審可按數字看降費案，小販也仍看得見真送貨被記在頁上。

paragraphs.en: The two fee trials used the same delivery list and published the changes experienced by both paying and public-line travelers.
paragraphs.zh: 兩費率試驗用同送貨單，公開付費者與公共隊各受何影響。

paragraphs.en: The judge accepted a reduced-fee plan while the team rejected a private reward. A bundle of returned postage labels supported Fang's prediction that many deliveries would change hands twice. Instead of seeking a reward, Mei asked them to refer the report to an independent review group and to show tolerance toward honest errors.
paragraphs.zh: 評審接受較低費率的方案，小隊拒絕私下獎賞。一疊退回郵資標籤支持方澤的預測：許多貨件需轉手兩次。梅嵐不求獎賞，而是請他們把報告轉交獨立審查組，並對誠實錯誤保持寬容。

paragraphs.en: The scoring contractor offered a deal if they stopped asking about the citywide formula.
paragraphs.zh: 評分承包商提議交易，條件是別再追問全市公式。

questions.question: Why are the same load and starting point used in both fee trials?
options: They prevent the public queue from appearing in the timing record.
They let the team compare the fee arrangements fairly.
They guarantee the reduced fee will make every journey faster.
questions.explanation: 兩次保留同貨單、載量與起點，才能比較費率影響，而非混入不同任務。

questions.question: How does Tang handle the private reward envelope?
options: She accepts it in exchange for ending the formula review.
She divides it among the judges before submitting the figures.
She returns it unopened and asks for the proposal in writing.
questions.explanation: 送信人答不出獎賞條件，唐悅退回未拆信封，要求書面說明。

paragraphs.en: The underground map lit up around an elevator that would not move during the planned blackout. Mei tapped the dead display once, then turned toward the scratched wall beside the manual socket instead of waiting for a machine the test had deliberately stopped.
paragraphs.zh: 地下圖圍著一部停電模擬時不會動的電梯發亮。梅嵐點一下死螢幕，轉向手動插座旁的刮牆，不再等測試刻意停掉的機器。

paragraphs.en: An artistic mural showed alternative routes blending like streams, with a circular blessing printed around its edge. Duan Ya said the picture was hopeful but not a map: real corridors needed exits drawn at their true locations.
paragraphs.zh: 藝術壁畫描繪替代路線像溪流般交融，邊緣印著圓形祝福語。段芽說畫面很有希望，但不是地圖：真實走廊必須把出口畫在正確位置。

paragraphs.en: The official diagram assumed a working lift even when electricity failed.
paragraphs.zh: 官方圖表假設停電時電梯仍可運作。

paragraphs.en: A manual socket and a scratched wall showed an older stair-free corridor. A cliff model stood behind a dusty instruction board. The instructor wore stage makeup, yet his diligence in checking emergency lamps impressed the group. He asked that nobody disturb the sealed control panel during the test.
paragraphs.zh: 手動插座與牆上刻痕指向較舊的無階梯走廊。懸崖模型立在滿是灰塵的指示板後。指導員畫著舞臺妝，但他勤勉檢查緊急照明的態度令大家敬佩。他要求測試時誰都不要碰封閉控制板。

paragraphs.en: Mei argued the old tunnel was too slow; Tang Yue said a route was useless if it disappeared during trouble. "It's embarrassing to lose time in a tunnel," Fang said. Mei laughed once. "Losing a stair-free exit would be worse."
paragraphs.zh: 梅嵐認為舊隧道太慢，唐悅則說危機時消失的路線毫無用處。「在隧道裡浪費時間有點難看，」方澤說。梅嵐輕笑：「失去無階梯出口更糟。」

paragraphs.en: Nowadays a recorded announcement repeats each station name, but its pronunciation is unclear to visitors. The agency planned publicity about the route; Tang Yue wanted to regulate sound levels and allow a calm retreat if the speakers failed.
paragraphs.zh: 如今錄音廣播重複每個站名，發音卻讓訪客難以辨認。機構計畫宣傳路線；唐悅希望規範音量，也提供喇叭故障時可安靜退出的路徑。

paragraphs.en: The instructor showed them the isolated lighting controls and confirmed that the service staff could end the simulation immediately. Tang asked where a participant could wait if the signs became unreadable. He pointed to a dry recess beside the entrance, and Yu checked that it did not block the return path. Duan drew that place before the lights changed. In the controlled dark, the emergency lamps worked, but the recorded station names echoed until Fang could not tell which corridor was being announced. They stopped at the agreed recess rather than dividing to search. Mei asked permission to inspect the manual panel from outside. Behind its approved cover, the older corridor's direction could be traced without restarting the lift. The team returned the lights to normal before staff opened that passage for a physical check. Duan added arrows at the two confusing turns and wrote a description that did not depend on hearing the speaker. Fang then timed the whole permitted corridor from entrance to exit, including a pause to read the instructions. The result was slower than the bright elevator diagram promised and still usable under the tested failure. Tang attached the instructor's written limits to the safety exception. When the contractor challenged their authority, she could point to who had approved the controls, which doors had opened, and which equipment nobody had touched.
paragraphs.zh: 指導員展示獨立照明控制，確認職員可立即結束模擬。唐悅問牌看不清時人在哪等，他指入口旁乾凹處，俞芊核實不擋退路，段芽先畫。受控黑暗中，緊急燈運作，錄音站名卻迴響到方澤分不清哪條廊。他們停在約定凹處，不分頭找。梅嵐申請從外查手動面板，核准蓋板後能追舊走廊方向，不須重啟電梯。眾人先恢復正常光，職員才開那段實查。段芽在兩個混淆彎加箭頭，寫不依賴聽廣播的說明。方澤再量整段允許通道，包含停下讀字。比亮電梯圖承諾的慢，卻在受測故障下仍能用。唐悅把指導員書面限制附安全豁免。承包商質疑權限時，她可指出誰核准控制、開過哪幾門、誰都沒碰哪些設備。

paragraphs.en: The corridor record included the controlled lighting failure, the physical inspection, and the full journey under the approved limits.
paragraphs.zh: 走廊紀錄包含受控照明故障、實體檢查，以及核准限制下的全程。

paragraphs.en: The public corridor remained open and the commission granted a temporary safety exception. Mei noticed a scratch beside a socket, near a technological exhibit about submarines. The mark revealed an old transportation tunnel; the team asked for permission before opening a panel, rather than mistaking an interesting exhibit for a safe exit.
paragraphs.zh: 公共走廊保持暢通，委員會給予暫時安全豁免。梅嵐注意到插座旁的刮痕，附近有潛艇科技展。刮痕揭露一條舊運輸隧道；小隊先申請許可才開板檢查，不把有趣展示誤當安全出口。

paragraphs.en: One contractor claimed the tests were beyond the team's authority. By this stage the team had evidence from streets, shops, homes, and tunnels. They could not accuse the entire contest of fraud from a single bad sign, but the repeated pattern demanded an independent hearing. Tang Yue assembled a case with dates and photographs instead of repeating the loudest rumors.
paragraphs.zh: 承包商指稱小隊測試超出權限。到了這一階段，小隊已有街道、店面、住家與隧道的證據。他們不能只憑一個錯誤標示就斷言整場競賽造假，但重複出現的模式需要獨立聽證。唐悅整理日期與照片成案，而不是重複最大聲的傳言。

questions.question: What does the team do when the blackout announcement is confusing?
options: It restarts the public elevator without asking staff.
It treats the artistic mural as a complete emergency map.
It waits at the agreed recess instead of splitting up to search.
questions.explanation: 廣播迴響難辨時，眾人停在事先約定且不擋退路的凹處，不分散找路。

questions.question: What supports the temporary safety exception?
options: The inspected corridor remains usable under the controlled failure.
The bright elevator diagram promises that no failure can occur.
The contractor cancels all limits on the team's tests.
questions.explanation: 在核准受控停電與實查下，舊無階梯廊仍可用，並附明確測試限制。

paragraphs.en: At the honeycomb gallery, six ticket windows faced a crowd that seemed unable to move. Yu Qian watched a family pause at the memorial display while newcomers behind them assumed the pause meant that every entrance was closed.
paragraphs.zh: 蜂巢藝廊六個售票窗面向不動的人群。俞芊看一家停在紀念展前，後方新來者誤以為停頓代表每個入口都關了。

paragraphs.en: An exhibit about a game addict stood beside a celebration hall. The curator asked visitors to distinguish the social aspect of play from harm, then offered a sealed container of old tickets as evidence of past events.
paragraphs.zh: 遊戲成癮者的展覽設在慶祝大廳旁。策展人請訪客區分遊戲的社會面向與其傷害，再拿出一盒封存的舊票作為過往活動的證據。

paragraphs.en: The automated model counted doors but never asked how long families paused inside.
paragraphs.zh: 自動模型只數門，不問家庭在裡面停留多久。

paragraphs.en: A gallery attendant noted that visitors often stopped for a memorial display. A glass gallery was arranged like a hive. A child knelt to examine a painted flea, while guards directed people toward an intensive demonstration area. Yu Qian noticed that families were gathering near the narrowest passage.
paragraphs.zh: 藝廊工作人員指出訪客常為紀念展停留。玻璃藝廊排得像蜂巢。孩子跪下看畫上的跳蚤，警衛引導大家進入密集展示區。俞芊注意到家庭正擠在最窄的通道旁。

paragraphs.en: Yu Qian suggested adding a quiet waiting place, while the judge favored maximum movement. "Six doors," the judge announced. "Six chances to enter," Yu Qian replied, "unless a crowd makes them one blocked doorway."
paragraphs.zh: 俞芊建議增設安靜等待處，評審卻重視最大流動量。「六道門，」評審宣布。「六次進場機會，」俞芊答，「除非人潮把它們擠成一道堵住的門。」

paragraphs.en: The lecturer pointed to a broken door knob and named the problem, namely a partial loss of access. Mei proposed preservation of the old entrance as a second route, provided engineers confirmed it would remain safe.
paragraphs.zh: 講師指著壞掉的門把指出問題：也就是部分通行能力喪失。梅嵐建議保留舊入口作第二路線，前提是工程師確認它仍安全。

paragraphs.en: Fang's first count treated each window as a separate opening. Mei showed him that all six queues turned into the same narrow passage. Duan drew the shape on a sheet large enough for the judge to see. She used small paper squares for groups, leaving them in place whenever a family stopped to read. After three rounds, the squares blocked the common turn even though most windows remained clear. The judge proposed shorter reading times. Yu asked the gallery attendant whether visitors came only to pass through or also to remember someone. The attendant brought a past event log showing how long people actually stayed. Tang asked to test a quiet waiting space beside the display, with a marked return to the route. The space could not obstruct the emergency exit, so Mei checked its edge with the engineer before moving the temporary benches. Volunteers entered in small, counted groups and chose whether to stop. Nobody was required to hurry past the memorial. Fang timed the queue from the outside door, including the moment each group could rejoin after its pause. The figures were less impressive than counting six open windows and more useful for explaining why the entrance cleared. Duan placed the tested capacity beside the drawing, not over the memorial text. When the witness brought the unpublished health advisory, Tang asked whether it described the same waiting conditions and who could confirm its date.
paragraphs.zh: 方澤初算把每窗當獨立開口，梅嵐指出六隊全轉入同一窄廊。段芽用大紙畫形狀，評審也看得見；用小紙方塊代表群組，一家停讀就讓方塊留下。三輪後，共用轉角堵住，大部分窗卻仍空。評審提議縮短閱讀，俞芊問工作人員訪客只來通過，還是也來紀念。職員拿過往活動簿，顯示真停留時間。唐悅要求試展旁安靜等候區，標回路。區域不能擋緊急出口，梅嵐和工程師查邊界才移臨時椅。志工按小組計數進場，自選是否停，不強迫匆匆越過紀念物。方澤從外門計排隊時間，含各組停後重新加入時刻。數字不如數六窗漂亮，卻更能說明入口為何疏通。段芽把受測容量寫圖旁，不蓋紀念文。見證人送未公開健康建議時，唐悅先問是否描述同等待條件，以及誰能證日期。

paragraphs.en: The gallery drawing connected six ticket windows to their shared narrow passage and marked the tested waiting capacity.
paragraphs.zh: 藝廊圖把六窗連向同窄廊，標明受測等待容量。

paragraphs.en: The crowded entrance cleared without denying anyone access. A promising plan should earn satisfaction from everyone it serves, not simply high scores. Tang Yue spoke in a respectful tone while a gardener sprinkled water on the grass. Through a small telescope, Duan Ya checked the exit sign across the gallery roof.
paragraphs.zh: 擁擠入口逐漸疏通，沒有拒絕任何人進場。有前景的方案應讓使用者滿意，而不是只求高分。園丁在草地灑水時，唐悅以尊重語氣說明。段芽透過小望遠鏡檢查藝廊屋頂另一端的出口牌。

paragraphs.en: A witness brought a copy of an unpublished health advisory.
paragraphs.zh: 一名見證人帶來未公開的健康建議書。

questions.question: Why does counting six ticket windows overstate the gallery's access?
options: All six queues feed into one narrow passage.
Five windows are permanently locked throughout the trial.
Every family enters through the emergency exit instead.
questions.explanation: 六窗共用同窄彎，入口數不能直接當可通行容量；停留還會影響隊伍。

questions.question: How is the memorial crowd managed in the successful test?
options: Visitors are forbidden to stop at the memorial display.
A checked waiting area lets families pause and rejoin the route.
Only people who promise not to read are admitted.
questions.explanation: 先查不擋緊急路，再設可停留與重入的空間，無須拒絕或催過紀念者。

paragraphs.en: The fifth walking trial ended beside a bench too hot to sit on comfortably. Yu Qian asked the volunteer to stop, and Fang closed his timing book before anyone could suggest that one more attempt would make the figures look cleaner.
paragraphs.zh: 第五次步行試走在燙得坐不住的椅旁結束。俞芊請志工停，方澤合上計時簿，免得有人提議再來一次，把數字弄漂亮。

paragraphs.en: Yu Qian offered assistance to demonstrate that an adequate resting place needed an agreeable surface, not just a decorative bench. The nearest water fountain was elsewhere, so the team measured the whole journey to it.
paragraphs.zh: 俞芊協助示範：足夠的休息空間需要舒適表面，不只是裝飾長椅。最近的飲水機在別處，因此小隊量測前往飲水機的完整路程。

paragraphs.en: The scoring tool treated rest as wasted time, even for exhausted travelers.
paragraphs.zh: 評分工具把休息視為浪費時間，即使旅客疲憊不堪。

paragraphs.en: A care worker's records showed that short stops reduced later delays. An old fax stood beside a memorial photograph of a dancer wearing bright lipstick. The exhibit discussed how maturity helped the community overcome painful losses. Tang Yue checked that the resting zone did not block visitors wishing to remember the dead.
